omni.title: Omni-chat — work only
omni.pickDialogHint: Left: all/new. Right: chats assigned to you.
omni.closeDialog: Close conversation (do not resolve the ticket)
omni.resolveHint: “Resolve ticket” stores a transcript snapshot and status in leads. The close icon only hides the conversation. Auto-close on silence can run after presence is released; a draft in the composer delays CLOSE.
omni.otherOperatorHint: This conversation is assigned to another operator — only they can reply (or a clinic owner can take it over).

errors.claimedByOtherOwner: This chat is assigned to another operator. Click “Take over” in the header.
errors.claimedByOther: Only the operator who claimed the ticket can reply.
errors.channelUnresolved: Could not determine a channel for the reply. Check channel settings.
errors.takeOverFailed: Could not take over the ticket
errors.presenceCloseFailed: Could not close the presence session. Clear the composer draft and try again.
errors.leadSnapshotFailed: Could not save the snapshot to the leads log.
errors.fileTypeDenied: This file type is not allowed
errors.saveKeysFailed: Could not save the keys. Try again.

patientChat.title: Patient chat
patientChat.subtitle: PWA conversations with patients. Text and attachments; voice — microphone or an audio file (no video circles). Up to 5 MB.
patientChat.emptyHint: Messages appear when patients write or send a voice note from the app.
patientChat.pickHint: Click a row on the left.
patientChat.aiLocalMode: AI summary and AI reply currently run in local mode (no external provider).
patientChat.aiDisabled: AI suggestions are currently disabled by the clinic administrator.
patientChat.claimTooltip: Marks the conversation as claimed. The “Mine” filter will show these conversations.
patientChat.voiceHint: Voice — microphone or an audio file; a caption is optional.

staff.title: Team chat
staff.subtitle: Internal clinic chat (no third-party messengers). Text, files, and voice notes — microphone button or an audio file. Video circles are not used.
staff.emptyRoomsHint: Create a group or message a colleague to start.
staff.pickHint: On the left — room history and colleagues. Open a direct chat or a channel to send messages.
staff.emptyThreadHint: Write a message or record a voice note (microphone). File or photo — via the icons; an attachment is added to the last sent text.
staff.composerHint: Ctrl+Enter to send. Voice — microphone or an audio file; an attachment is added to the last sent message.
staff.inviteHint: Available for groups and task chats. Only staff of this clinic can be members.
staff.groupHint: You and the selected members will be added to the group.

notify.title: Notification channels
notify.intro: Configure Telegram, SMS, and Email for reminders and notifications. Settings are stored for the selected clinic.

omniChannels.title: Omnichannel channels
omniChannels.intro: Connect the channels clients use to write to you (Telegram, WhatsApp, Viber, Max, SMS, email, and others). Messages from them flow into Unified chat.
omniChannels.emptyHint: Create the first channel to connect messengers and other sources.

credentials.telegramBotDesc: Bot token from @BotFather. Used to send messages to clients. Do not share this token.
credentials.telegramWebhookDesc: Optional secret for verifying Telegram webhooks (X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token header). Use the same string as in the bot webhook settings.
credentials.telegramAdminChatDesc: A personal Telegram chat or group where the bot sends alerts (operator request, AI drafts, and booking notices when enabled). To find the ID, message @userinfobot in that chat or read update.message.chat.id on the webhook.
credentials.whatsappUrlDesc: Base WhatsApp Cloud API URL for sending messages. Example: https://graph.facebook.com/v20.0/<PHONE_NUMBER_ID>/messages. Copy from the Meta Developers examples.
credentials.whatsappTokenDesc: Permanent WhatsApp Cloud API Access Token from Meta (Access Tokens). Used to authorize outbound messages.
credentials.whatsappPhoneDesc: WhatsApp business Phone Number ID, not the phone number itself. Find it under WhatsApp → Phone numbers in Meta Developers.
credentials.viberTokenDesc: Viber bot authentication token. Copy from the Viber cabinet (Bot Settings → Authentication token). Sent as X-Viber-Auth-Token when sending messages and setting the webhook.
credentials.vkGroupDesc: VK community ID (group_id) the bot writes as. Copy the number from the group URL or the community API settings.
credentials.vkTokenDesc: VK community access token with messages permission. Created in community settings → API → Access keys. Do not confuse it with a user token.
credentials.maxUrlDesc: Base API URL of the external chat service (Max Chat). Example: https://max-chat.example.com/api. Confirm the address in the provider docs.
credentials.maxKeyDesc: API key (secret token) for Max Chat. Copy from the service cabinet. Stored encrypted.
credentials.maxWebhookDesc: Optional secret for verifying inbound Max Chat webhooks. Use the same string as in the service webhook settings.
credentials.smsLoginDesc: SMS provider account login (for example SMSC.ru). Used to authorize outbound SMS.
credentials.smsPasswordDesc: Password or API key for the SMS provider HTTP API. Prefer the provider-issued API key over the cabinet password.
credentials.smsSenderDesc: SMS sender name. It must be approved and activated with the SMS provider (for example “CLINIC”).
credentials.imapHostDesc: Mailbox IMAP server. Confirm with the email provider (for example imap.gmail.com, imap.mail.ru).
credentials.imapPortDesc: IMAP port (usually 993 for IMAPS). Confirm in the email provider settings.
credentials.inboxEmailDesc: This mailbox address. Clients write here; messages land in unified chat.
credentials.imapUserDesc: Mailbox login for IMAP (often the full address user@example.com).
credentials.imapPasswordDesc: Mailbox password or an app password if the provider requires one.
credentials.otherJsonDesc: Arbitrary JSON with integration settings. Use only with developer instructions: the format depends on the provider.

vault.title: Omni-Vault (media and export)
vault.emptyMediaHint: Uploaded files (X-rays, photos, video) will appear here. Filter by type and date.
vault.emptyVoiceHint: Voice messages and transcripts (waveform + auto transcription) will appear here when the API is available.
vault.previewHint: A live table will appear when columns are selected and the export API is available.
vault.selectedLine: Columns selected: {{count}}. Rows: from export data.
vault.backupHint: Full data dump. When ready, a link is sent to Telegram (if configured).

aiSettings.intro: Global settings and per-channel overrides (Telegram, web chat, and others).
aiSettings.defaultHint: For the whole clinic; channels below can override the mode.
aiSettings.byChannelHint: Overrides for Telegram, the site widget, and other channels.
aiSettings.noChannels: No channels configured. Add channels in Unified chat / Omnichannel channels.
